title: Mid-stream cut fixtures disconnect before any text is sent
observed: errors-stream-cut-midtext and errors-disconnect-midstream timed out in runs c1, c3 and final: the partial reply never appears. curl against the fixture returned 236 bytes (message_start only) and zero text_delta events, because disconnect_after counts raw SSE bytes including framing and was set to 32 and 60.
expected: The cut lands mid-text so the partial reply, the retry and the continuation are all observable.
